feeds.title: Jump Rope Dudes Blog
feeds.description: Hi there. We're Dan and Brandon (The Jump Rope Dudes.) We're here to help you get lean and live more by incorporating jump rope into your fitness routine. We make fitness fun and accessible to everyone in the world.

feeds.title: Crossrope Blog
feeds.description: Crossrope weighted jump ropes offer fun workouts that fit your busy schedule. Weighted jump ropes activate more muscle groups & burn more calories than regular jump ropes. Browse our blog for customer success stories, advice, and tips on our favorite training system.

feeds.title: Jump Rope Now Blog
feeds.description: Jumping rope is more than just physical exercise. It is a safe and fun sport for practically anyone. It is an excellent way to not only get in shape but stay in shape. We've experimented with different weights of handles and ropes, and found the ideal balance. It's the Perfect Weight. With thorough experimentation as well as feedback from numerous testers, we fine-tuned the design for maximum performance. Read our blogs for all things jump roping, integrating health, and all the fun content that's on its way.

feeds.title: Buddy Lee Blog
feeds.description: At Buddy Lee Jump Ropes, we pride ourselves in offering you the highest quality jump ropes, skipping ropes, and training programs for your fitness/sports training needs. Read jump rope training guides from Buddy Lee to improve your skills and jump rope workouts.

feeds.title: Here Rope Blog
feeds.description: Here rope weighted jump rope for fitness allows you to burn over 1,000 calories in an hour of jumping compared to other common activities. Heavier Ropes, Better Workout. The mission is to make the whole city your gym with our jump ropes

feeds.title: Coach Nate K-G Blog
feeds.description: Through jumping over a decade, I've realized that there are so many different styles and applications for jump rope. Whether you want to mimic the style of Floyd Mayweather, focus solely on double unders during your workout, or explore the massive universe of freestyle skills, you will find something that works for you! And my mission is to give you as many resources as possible!

feeds.title: Ropeworks With Rene Bibaud Blog
feeds.description: Ropeworks is the creation of Rene Bibaud. Rene is a five-time world champion, former ESPN commentator for the sport of jumping rope, and artist and coach of the renowned Cirque Du Soleil. She is an educator, motivational speaker, and entertainer with a special focus on fitness and specialty performances. She excels at sharing the benefits of the single best fitness tool available - the jump rope.

feeds.title: Jump Rope Mom Blog
feeds.description: Jumping rope is my jam! I'm here to inspire of all you to pick up a jump rope, learn new skills, get fit, and have fun while doing it! Read the blog and learn how to jump rope for all levels of fitness. From beginner jump rope tutorials to full-body jump rope workouts. Learn all the skills and drills you need to master jumping rope and get in the best shape of your life!

feeds.title: Elevate Rope Blog
feeds.description: At Elevate Rope it is our mission to revolutionize cardio fitness and change the negative perception of cardio workouts worldwide. We strive to make cardio exercise accessible, enjoyable, and fun for all so that people everywhere can experience the benefits of a healthy and active lifestyle.

feeds.title: Elite Jumps
feeds.description: We believe in doing hard things. Early mornings. Late nights. Jumpathons. Workouts. HIIT sessions. That's why we build the best possible tools for making the jump to the next level. Our focus is empowering people with quality tools to grow more than they thought possible.
